selection_rule: For each K in priority order 60 then 32, count historical classes having at least 3 qualifying independent mocks at that K.
Select the first K with at least 10 such historical classes.
If neither K qualifies, STOP V3 permanently at neutral 1.00.
At the selected K, evaluate N in priority order 5 then 4 then 3.
Select the largest N for which at least 10 historical classes have at least N qualifying independent mocks.
If no N qualifies, STOP V3 permanently at neutral 1.00.

candidate_union_channels_in_order.description: Publisher robots.txt-declared XML sitemaps plus conventional /sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml endpoints for each frozen domain.
Internet Archive CDX URL index queries scoped to each frozen domain and the applicable anchor-year date window.
Common Crawl URL index queries scoped to each frozen domain and applicable anchor-year records.

deterministic_enumeration_protocol.enumeration_order: domain frame order, then channel order, then canonical URL lexicographic order
deterministic_enumeration_protocol.late_found_url_policy: A URL not produced by the frozen enumeration protocol is non-gating and cannot enter the V3 predictor.

sort_key: absolute calendar-day distance from September 30 ascending

forbidden_before_B31: player-position extraction from V3 gating mocks

future_predictor_architecture_constraint.classes_below_N_use: excluded from historical association; prospective class remains neutral 1.00
future_predictor_architecture_constraint.ensemble_aggregation: arithmetic mean of per-mock capital, then natural log

ground_truth_source_qualification_contra.access_control_rule: Do not spoof identity, rotate IPs, bypass authentication, defeat bot protection, or evade publisher controls.
ground_truth_source_qualification_contra.anchor_window: Publication date must fall within plus/minus 8 calendar days of September 30 in the anchor year.
ground_truth_source_qualification_contra.date_evidence: Publication date must be supported by visible first-party page text or first-party page metadata such as JSON-LD/article metadata; search snippets do not count.
ground_truth_source_qualification_contra.derivative_exclusion: Exclude syndicated/reposted copies and mocks explicitly described as derived from another included mock or consensus product.
ground_truth_source_qualification_contra.explicit_slot_coverage: Must contain unique explicit selection slots 1 through K in the rendered or first-party structured content. No inferred, imputed, or invented slots.
ground_truth_source_qualification_contra.independence: Each included mock must have both a distinct publisher domain and a distinct named author relative to every other included mock in that class.
ground_truth_source_qualification_contra.mock_type: Must be an authored NFL mock draft with explicit selection slots; exclude big boards, prospect rankings, consensus boards, simulators, user-generated mocks, fantasy rookie mocks, and articles merely discussing another mock.
ground_truth_source_qualification_contra.public_access: Full relevant mock content must be viewable in a normal unauthenticated browser session without login, paid subscription, or circumvention of access controls.
ground_truth_source_qualification_contra.publisher_and_author: Publisher domain must be in the frozen domain frame and a named individual author must be attributable from first-party page evidence.
ground_truth_source_qualification_contra.reproducible_capture: At least one approved non-circumventing capture mode validated in B28 must reproduce the structural evidence needed for qualification.

hard_stop_rules: B28 instrument validation fails after one permitted correction cycle
B29 finds fewer than 10 historical classes at K=32 with at least 3 qualifying independent mocks
Any integrity violation revealing historical actual-capital outcomes before the association stage
Any post-B27 addition/removal/substitution of discovery domains for gating analysis
Any use of 2027 player composition or source count to choose K or N
objective: Prospectively freeze how V3 will discover and qualify independent early-season NFL mock drafts, and how predictor depth K and ensemble size N will be selected using source availability only, before discovering any new V3 candidate sources.

publisher_domain_frame_v1.purpose: Frozen discovery universe. Domain inclusion does not imply source qualification.
publisher_domain_frame_v1.selection_basis: Established national/general NFL publishers and specialist NFL/draft publishers known before V3 source enumeration. Frozen before any V3 candidate search, outcome opening, or player-composition inspection.

v3_stage_sequence.B28: Instrument validation on a separate labeled calibration set; no 2027 anchor-window gating pages and no actual-capital outcomes.
v3_stage_sequence.B29: Historical 2013-2026 source-only enumeration and qualification audit; select K and N using the frozen availability-only rule.
v3_stage_sequence.B30: 2027 prospective source-only feasibility using the already-selected K and N. If fewer than N qualify, 2027 remains neutral.
v3_stage_sequence.B31: Freeze exact predictor and statistical architecture before player/position construction or outcomes.
v3_stage_sequence.B32: Construct historical slot-position predictors and sealed 2027 predictor under the frozen architecture.
v3_stage_sequence.B33: Single-shot historical association test; actual capital opens for the first time.
v3_stage_sequence.B34_plus: Only if B33 passes its preregistered gates: calibration/shadow/display work. Production remains separately gated.
